# Design system guidance

Use three layers of CSS tokens: primitives for raw values, semantic aliases for
purpose, and component-specific tokens for controls. Build component specs for
default, hover, active, disabled, focus, loading, error and success states.

Avoid raw color values in component rules. Use mobile-first layouts, clear
tokens for spacing/type/radius/shadow/duration, and keep accessible contrast,
keyboard focus, resilient copy, and responsive behavior part of the design
definition. `DESIGN.md` is authoritative for this product's brand decisions.
